title: Deep Research
subtitle: Multi-source research reports with citations
pitch: Ask a specific question. We search, read, and return a manager-ready report with sources.
premiumWarn: Premium runs the same deep-research engine with a longer report budget. Prefer Deep for most work.

mode.quickDesc: Fast brief with light web search — about 1–2 minutes
mode.premiumDesc: Same deep-research engine, longer fuller report

queryPlaceholder: What should we research? Be specific…
focusPlaceholder: e.g. last 12 months, Iran market, compare vendors…
attachHint: Optional PDFs or images for Deep and Premium
cancelHint: Stops waiting for the result. The model call may finish billing shortly after.
sourcesEmpty: No structured sources returned for this run.

market.label: Market
market.query: What is the current size and growth outlook for the Iran e-commerce market for mid-size retailers?
market.focus: Last 24 months; include major players and risks for Iranian SMEs

competitors.label: Competitors
competitors.query: Compare the top Iranian digital banking / neobank offerings for retail customers
competitors.focus: Features, fees, strengths/weaknesses; cite public sources

regulation.label: Regulation
regulation.query: What regulations and compliance requirements affect personal data processing for SaaS companies operating in Iran?
regulation.focus: Manager-level summary; not legal advice; note uncertainty

vendor.label: Vendor
vendor.query: Evaluate options for enterprise laptop procurement for a 200-person company in Iran
vendor.focus: Price bands, support, import/availability constraints; decision criteria

progress.title: Research in progress
progress.working: Reviewing sources and drafting the report…
progress.expectQuick: Quick research usually takes about 10–15 minutes.
progress.expectDeep: Deep research often takes several minutes while sources are gathered and synthesized.
progress.expectPremium: Premium can take longer — keep this page open until it finishes.
progress.stay: Keep this page open until research finishes. Closing or leaving may stop the process.
progress.stayBackground: You can leave this page; we will notify you when the report is ready.

errors.network: Connection lost while researching. Check network and try again.
errors.timeout: Research timed out. Try Quick mode or a shorter question.
